# Raushan Ranjan (Raushan Sir)

> Raushan Ranjan, known to learners as Raushan Sir, is a Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT) and AI and cloud developer based in Noida, India, and the creator of RR Skillverse, a free learning platform. He has trained 4,000+ professionals across 175+ enterprise batches in 25+ countries, holds 12 active certifications, and builds AI agents and full-stack solutions on Azure, Power Platform and .NET.

## Identity
- Name: Raushan Ranjan. Also known as: Raushan Sir, RR.
- Role: Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT). Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.
- Work history: Koenig Solutions, July 2022 to September 2026 (Corporate Trainer and .NET Developer; Senior Corporate Trainer; Iconic Corporate Trainer with a Trainer Plus team-lead role). RR Education, own coaching centre, 2014 to 2022 (physics and mathematics).
- Education: B.Tech, Information Technology, ABES Engineering College, Ghaziabad (2019 to 2023).

## Verified figures
- 4,000+ professionals trained across 175+ enterprise batches, 40+ organisations, 25+ countries (2022 to 2026).
- 11+ years across education and technology training (7+ years teaching physics and mathematics, 4+ years enterprise technology training).
- 12 active certifications: Microsoft Certified Trainer (since August 2023); 10 Microsoft certifications (AI-103, AI-200, DP-600, AZ-204, PL-200, PL-400, PL-300, DP-900, PL-900, AZ-900); CompTIA Data+. AZ-305 passed; Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-104), AI-901 and AB-410 in progress.

## Platforms and projects
- RR Skillverse (https://rrskillverse.in): his free, non-commercial learning platform (notes, handbooks, blogs, AI tools; Axiom AI assistant).
- RRCareerOS: his evidence-based career platform (explainable job matching, claim-checked resumes, learning plans, grounded assistant) on Azure.
- RR Education: his coaching centre (2014 to 2022).
- AI agents and tools: Ask SOT, Kite Konnect, RRPulse, SMI Agent, MS Notes Generator, AI Academy, JARVIS, RR Finman, Compact Mode (GitHub Copilot and Claude), RR Skillverse Skills, CAMEL Sentinel.
